evidence: Full fifteen-stage isolated verifier on the final input 5ecd49a317171e493451894bcc082cd8d4516d2922c29564107baace9d21dd68: 547 tests, 5 opt-in skips, 0 failures; packaged unsigned app smoke and helper stages passed.

Isolated reruns: exit 0 without a report, a different helper's report, a moved/replaced helper and an inherited environment never yield verified; app-off, access-off, stale, absent and fresh evidence are classified and stamped accurately, with freshness read from the persisted_state_as_of the real backend publishes (StorageSummaryContract); the real connector's --self-check reports its identity and never registers a session; session register requires a live ancestor pid and refuses before any IPC; the default socket is canonical across session, doctor and the IPC client (AC-TASK-562-01).

Non-vacuity on the final candidate: disabling the identity check, inheriting the environment, dropping the pid requirement or reading freshness from the wrong key each makes the targeted fixture fail; static delta review dispositions: F1 P1: fixed.

Assurance reviewed: IMPACT-TASK-562-ATTRIBUTION, IMPACT-TASK-562-CLIENTS, IMPACT-TASK-562-QUERY, IMPACT-TASK-562-MCP, IMPACT-TASK-562-IPC confirmed; INSPECT-TASK-562-1 performed and sufficient after the implementation event; findings on these assets: FIND-ATTRIBUTION, FIND-ENDPOINT-ORDER, FIND-ISOLATION, FIND-OCCURRENCE, FIND-QUERY, FIND-SERVICE; changed files lie inside the CLIENTS, ATTRIBUTION, MCP, QUERY (AppEvidenceQueryBackend) and STORE-adjacent Core IPC (StorageSummaryContract) locators; any drift reconciled to the matching IMPACT-TASK-562-* record.

limitations: Fixture runners stand in for real client processes; the real helper is exercised against a recording socket server.
Native installed clients are not exercised.
The auditor also implemented the task; independence rests on isolated reruns, mutation reds, the independent static review and archived hashes.
